description: Shared XLSX semantic cases. The Rust core extractor and the Python portable extractor must agree on every outcome, so both test suites read this file rather than restating expectations. `expected` lists the attributable display cells. `unattributed` lists cells that convert but whose display text is not reproduced; Rust retains them as non-attributable cells for its annotation diagnostic, while the Python extractor reports them in `unattributed_cells`.

cases.name: boolean_out_of_domain_value
cases.reason: A boolean cell may only hold 0 or 1; 2 is not a valid ST_Boolean value.

cases.name: boolean_non_numeric_value
cases.reason: A boolean cell must be encoded as 0 or 1, never as the literal TRUE.

cases.name: coordinate_malformed
cases.reason: A cell reference must be column letters followed by a row number.

cases.name: coordinate_column_out_of_range
cases.reason: Column ZZZZ exceeds the 16384 column maximum.

cases.name: coordinate_row_zero
cases.reason: Row numbers are one-based, so row 0 is invalid.

cases.name: unknown_cell_type
cases.reason: An unrecognized cell type must not be silently treated as a number.

cases.name: shared_string_index_out_of_range
cases.reason: A shared string index beyond the table must not resolve to empty text.

cases.name: external_worksheet_relationship
cases.reason: An external worksheet relationship must never be dereferenced.

cases.name: non_worksheet_relationship_target
cases.reason: A worksheet relationship pointing outside xl/worksheets/ must be refused rather than yielding an empty sheet.

cases.name: parent_traversal_relationship_target
cases.reason: A relationship target must not escape the package via parent traversal.

cases.name: iso_date_cell_invalid_calendar_day
cases.reason: 2026 is not a leap year, so the value is unattributable rather than fatal.

cases.name: custom_percent_two_decimals
cases.styles: <numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.00%"/></numFmts><cellXfs count="2"><xf numFmtId="0"/><xf numFmtId="164" applyNumberFormat="1"/></cellXfs>

cases.name: unreproducible_currency_format_is_unattributable
cases.reason: An unsupported number format must not fail conversion; the cell converts but is omitted from attribution.
